Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You snap your fingers and send a bright spark toward your target. At your gesture it blossoms into flame or scatters into a spray of frost, striking with a sudden shove.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within 5 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

Choose fire or cold before rolling. Make one Guile attack against the target.

Weak
Deal 3 damage of the chosen type.
Standard
Deal 3 damage of that type and push the target 1 square.
Strong
Deal 5 damage of that type and push the target 2 squares.
